arxiv-2110-05645.title: A Global Convergence Theory for Deep ReLU Implicit Networks via Over-parameterization
arxiv-2110-05645.creator: Tianxiang Gao, Hailiang Liu, Jia Liu, Hridesh Rajan, Hongyang Gao
arxiv-2110-05645.description: Abstract Implicit deep learning has received increasing attention recently, since it generalizes the recursive prediction rules of many commonly used neural network architectures. Its prediction rule is provided implicitly based on the solution of an equilibrium equation. Although many recent studies have experimentally demonstrates its superior performances, the theoretical understanding of implicit neural networks is limited.

arxiv-2202-03872.creator: Yingli Ran, Yaoyao Zhang, Zhao Zhang
arxiv-2202-03872.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yingli Ran, Yaoyao Zhang, Zhao Zhang. This paper studies the minimum weight set cover (MinWSC) problem with a small neighborhood cover (SNC) property proposed by Agarwal et al. arxiv-2210-16185.title: Adaptive importance sampling based on fault tree analysis for piecewise deterministic Markov process
arxiv-2210-16185.creator: Guillaume Chennetier, Hassane Chraibi, Anne Dutfoy, Josselin Garnier
arxiv-2210-16185.description: Abstract Piecewise deterministic Markov processes (PDMPs) can be used to model complex dynamical industrial systems. The counterpart of this modeling capability is their simulation cost, which makes reliability assessment untractable with standard Monte Carlo methods. A significant variance reduction can be obtained with an adaptive importance sampling (AIS) method based on a cross-entropy (CE) procedure.

arxiv-2309-11598.title: A theory satisfying a strong version of Tennenbaum’s theorem
arxiv-2309-11598.creator: Patrick Lutz, James Walsh
arxiv-2309-11598.description: Abstract . We answer a question of Pakhomov by showing that there is a consistent, c.e. theory T T such that no theory which is definitionally equivalent to T T has a computable model. A key tool in our proof is the model-theoretic notion of mutual algebraicity. 1.

arxiv-2503-12946.title: Open3DBench: Open-Source Benchmark for 3D-IC Backend Implementation and PPA Evaluation
arxiv-2503-12946.creator: Yunqi Shi*, Chengrui Gao*, Wanqi Ren, Peng Xie, Siyuan Xu, Ke Xue, Mingxuan Yuan, Chao Qian, Zhi-Hua Zhou
arxiv-2503-12946.description: Abstract This paper introduces Open3DBench, a comprehensive open-source 3D-IC backend benchmark suite built upon the OpenROAD-flow-scripts (ORFS) [ 1 ] framework to address the lack of standardized evaluation infrastructures. The framework supports a complete 3D backend design cycle, featuring 3D PDK preparation for tiered stacking, 3D partitioning, placement, timing optimization, 3D routing, and rigorous post-route timing and thermal analysis.

arxiv-2506-13412.title: Triplet Higgs assisted leptogenesis from axion oscillation after inflation
arxiv-2506-13412.creator: Sasmita Mishra
arxiv-2506-13412.description: Abstract Leptogenesis via axion oscillation after inflation is an alternate mechanism of thermal leptogenesis. In this mechanism, the requirement of the existence of a lepton number ( L L ) violating process in equilibrium to drive the lepton number requires the temperature of leptogenesis at ∼ 10 13 \sim 10^{13} GeV.

arxiv-2511-18813.title: Uncertainty of Network Topology with Applications to Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2511-18813.creator: Sing-Yuan Yeh, Chun-Hao Yang
arxiv-2511-18813.description: Abstract Persistent homology (PH) is a crucial concept in computational topology, providing a multiscale topological description of a space. It is particularly significant in topological data analysis, which aims to make statistical inference from a topological perspective. In this work, we introduce a new topological summary for Bayesian neural networks, termed the predictive topological uncertainty (pTU) .

pmc-10586201.title: Lysyl oxidase-like 1-antisense 1 (LOXL1-AS1) lncRNA differentially regulates gene and protein expression, signaling and morphology of human ocular cells
pmc-10586201.creator: Heather M Schmitt, Kristyn M Hake, Kristin M Perkumas, Brandon M Lê, Maria F Suarez, Michael L De Ieso, Rashad S Rahman, William M Johnson, María Gomez-Caraballo, Allison E Ashley-Koch, Michael A Hauser, W Daniel Stamer
pmc-10586201.description: Pseudoexfoliation glaucoma (PEXG) is characterized by dysregulated extracellular matrix (ECM) homeostasis that disrupts conventional outflow function and increases intraocular pressure (IOP). Prolonged IOP elevation results in optic nerve head damage and vision loss. Uniquely, PEXG is a form of open angle glaucoma that has variable penetrance, is difficult to treat and does not respond well to common IOP-lowering pharmaceuticals.

pmc-10743648.title: Untangling Irregular Actin Cytoskeleton Architectures in Tomograms of the Cell with Struwwel Tracer
pmc-10743648.creator: Salim Sazzed, Peter Scheible, Jing He, Willy Wriggers, Slavica Jonić
pmc-10743648.description: In this work, we established, validated, and optimized a novel computational framework for tracing arbitrarily oriented actin filaments in cryo-electron tomography maps. Our approach was designed for highly complex intracellular architectures in which a long-range cytoskeleton network extends throughout the cell bodies and protrusions.

pmc-11473962.title: EEG-based emotional valence and emotion regulation classification: a data-centric and explainable approach
pmc-11473962.creator: Linda Fiorini, Francesco Bossi, Francesco Di Gruttola
pmc-11473962.description: Emotion classification using electroencephalographic (EEG) data is a challenging task in the field of Artificial Intelligence. While many researchers have focused on finding the best model or feature extraction technique to achieve optimal results, few have attempted to select the best methodological steps for working with the dataset.

pmc-11574094.title: Action plan strategies for a new approach to the combination of yeast and ultrasonic waves for the reduction of heavy metal residues in rice
pmc-11574094.creator: Bohlooli Shahnaz, Ramezan Yousef, Hosseini Hedayat, Eskandari Soheyl, Esfarjani Fatemeh
pmc-11574094.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). This study was conducted to combine two physical (ultrasonic) and biological (Saccharomyces cerevisiae) methods to reduce heavy metals such as Arsenic (As), Cadmium (Cd), and Lead (Pb) in rice, which is the most widely consumed grain.

pmc-11710087.title: Initial symptoms in individuals with Alzheimer’s or mixed Alzheimer’s‐Lewy body dementia are noted at an older age and are more likely to be amnestic in African Americans than Whites
pmc-11710087.creator: Quintasha Beamon, Audrey Zhu, James Bena, James B Leverenz, Jagan A. Pillai
pmc-11710087.description: BackgroundAmnestic initial symptoms are common in Alzheimer’s disease(AD). However initial non‐amnestic (language, executive or visuospatial) symptoms are seen in ∼20% and associated with faster progression. Given racial differences in clinical and biomarker characteristics in AD, we explored if initial cognitive symptoms differed by race of the participants among autopsy confirmed AD, Lewy body pathology (LBP) and mixed pathology (AD‐LBP).

pmc-12618577.title: Hydrochemical characteristics and controlling factors of polder area in Chaohu Lake Basin, China
pmc-12618577.creator: Min Liu, Mingyang Huang, Yuxuan Zhu, Liangyuan Zhao, Hongbing Tan, Yuting Zhang, Junfeng Gao, Huawei Huang, Cheng Han, Shengfei Deng, Mingli Wu
pmc-12618577.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Polder areas are typical geographic units in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River and subject to intensive anthropogenic influence, resulting in complex hydrochemical processes. Current understanding of these processes remains incomplete, limiting effective water resource management. This study employs an integrated approach combining hydrochemical diagrams, isotope tracing, and multivariate statistics to elucidate the spatiotemporal patterns and controlling mechanisms of ion composition in polder waters, and to quantitatively attribute ion sources.

pmc-12619509.title: Predictors of low-level viremia in chronic hepatitis B and the efficacy of pegylated interferon-alpha: a real-world study
pmc-12619509.creator: Wenyuan Zhang, Jia Chen, Wenjin Sun, Nana Xie, Fangbing Tian, Wencong Zhang, Qiurong Ruan, Jianxin Song
pmc-12619509.description: BackgroundLow-level viremia (LLV) is closely associated with the prognosis of patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), it can increase the incidence of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Our research aims to explore how to identify LLV early and implement effective therapeutic intervention.MethodsThis retrospective study included 720 patients who were either treatment-naive or had not received treatment within the past 5 years.

pmc-12847720.title: National-scale landslide susceptibility and risk mapping of India using a hybrid data-driven approach
pmc-12847720.creator: Imran Khan, Harish Bahuguna, Ashutosh Kainthola, Rayees Ahmed, Md. Sarfaraz Asgher
pmc-12847720.description: Landslides pose a persistent and deadly hazard across India’s diverse terrain, demanding robust, high-resolution national-scale assessments to guide effective risk mitigation and policy decisions. This study addresses a critical research gap in landslide susceptibility and risk assessment across India at a high spatial resolution of 90 m × 90 m on a national scale.

pmc-13259175.title: Zynq-Based Hardware–Software Codesign Architecture for an Intelligent Hyperspectral Camera
pmc-13259175.creator: Lufan Xie, Lijing Zhang, Fan Yang, Mengchen Lin, Jiadong Wang, Shengxiang Cao, Chenlong Zhang, Di Liu, Mingzhong Pan, Jin Yang
pmc-13259175.description: Traditional hyperspectral cameras transmit full data cubes to host computers, creating severe bandwidth and storage bottlenecks that impede real-time analysis. We present a Zynq-7035-based intelligent camera using hardware–software codesign to enable on-board processing and transmit only actionable results. This intelligent camera is designed for high-throughput edge-sensing tasks, prioritizing rapid detection and information extraction over exhaustive raw data acquisition.
